text:
emma: Follow-up from the authz postmortem — I posted a short remediation checklist: https://tiny.redwood/authz-actions. Ask: please claim items and add any blockers & ETA.

zack: I can take token-validation telemetry + alerts (item 1). Will add a Splunk filter and provisional thresholds. ETA 3 business days.

reena: I’ll own secrets rotation automation (item 3). Plan: KMS dual-version rollout + job to expire CI tokens flagged as long-lived. ETA 10 days.

infra-bot: Created tickets: PM-6021 (telemetry-alerts), PM-6022 (secrets-rotation), PM-6023 (runbook-escalation). Links: https://tracker.redwood/PM-6022

emma: Quick notes: (1) add a "legacy_flag" in the tracker for tokens that need migration; (2) compliance requires GDPR/CCPA tags & retention justification on each PM.

zack: Added sample query to PM-6021: `event=token_validation OR event=token_issue | stats count by service, result` and provisional spike rule 0.5% over 5m. Will patch in alert doc.

reena: I uploaded a KMS map to PM-6022 and suggested rotating the affected key within 7 days unless it blocks prod. Will include rollback steps / dual-acceptance window in PR.

emergency-bot: Reminder: weekly checkpoint created for PM-6021 & PM-6022 every Wed 09:00 PT.

emma: If rotation or telemetry changes cause customer-facing auth failures, label ticket `blocking` and ping #eng-oncall immediately per the runbook. Also scheduling 20m sync Thu 09:30 PT.

zack: Ack. I’ll wire alerting into staging and post results in PM-6021 before Thu.

reena: PR opened for rotation scripts: git.redwood/pr/1620. Will attach test plan & runbook steps to PM-6022.

emergency-bot: Compliance reminder: attach data-classification and retention notes before marking PMs done.

emma: Thanks all — update the tracker as you make progress and drop PRs/docs in the ticket comments. See you Thu. :thumbsup:
